scope: Same price-blind selected current-margin-eligible symbols, same fixed 32 action clocks, same old native broker authentic BID/ASK receipts; NO new timestamps, instruments or requests. Original broker spread research result was encrypted and not inspected before new design freeze. This is developmental outcome-blind reuse, NOT independent confirmation.
hypothesis: Cross-asset native quote state at t explains incremental future 5minute broker spread over the previously frozen own-symbol six-coordinate model.
novelty: Distinct cross-instrument causal liquidity-context information for future economic friction, not directional price lead-lag, quote catch-up, bid/ask revision directional pressure, FX return ranking, triad price momentum, or cash/futures basis. The previous original exact remains unchanged.
peer_selection: For target symbol at action t include every OTHER selected instrument from DIFFERENT asset_class with full causal t-300,t two-sided quotes; require at least2 peers; no realized-return choice.

target: Exact ORIGINAL future authentic broker spread bps at t+300s, never fills or trade net.
frozen_baseline: Exactly previously persisted own six-coordinate centered ridge forecast for the same symbol/action/target. Do not rerun own scientific model. Compare paired on intersection of original baseline support and cross-asset support.
new_model: Expanding per-symbol 8-coordinate centered ridge lambda25, intercept unpenalized, min6 strictly prior matured observations with full peer and own information, no threshold or horizon retune.
missingness: If any own causal quote missing or fewer than2 cross-class peers, or training under6, or original frozen prediction/response unsupported, abstain; record all denominators in all original blocks and complete ISO weeks35-37. Do not use old model on non-paired rows.
inference: Shared original observed data and dependent four calendar blocks, no IID or familywise p certification. This second arm adds to multiplicity/selection exposure; no independent confirmation.
economic: Cost-information forecasting cannot demonstrate positive directional NET expectancy, portfolio alpha, actual fills or HARD21; historical fees financing conversion execution remains UNKNOWN.
governance: No orders, no protected forward, no raw public data, owner encrypted results, all original frozen source and negative closures retained.
